cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: This Form N-PX Annual Report of Proxy Voting Record (the "Report") is being filed by Two Sigma Investments, LP ("TSI") jointly with its affiliate, Two Sigma Advisers, LP ("TSA"). The proxy votes for which TSI and TSA exercised voting power during the reporting period are reported separately in this Report. As of January 1, 2026, TSI manages all of the clients that were previously managed by TSA, and TSA no longer provides services to any clients, manages any client assets, or exercises voting power over any securities involving reportable voting matters.
